static_traits.name: Chen Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友关系Good,但对该Fearnot易敞开
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;既往without类似心理问题;without接受过心理治疗的经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性较好,配合度高,能进行自我Reflection;Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直有一个持续性的想法:因为我是独生子,最终会在have not人照顾的情况下Loneliness地死去.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this persistent thought is affecting my mental health and bringing pain, so I seek counseling; I need help to cope with and relieve this thought's impact on me.
growth_experiences: 自小为独生子,without兄弟姐妹.近几年这一身份逐渐引发对not yet来缺乏支持系统的担忧;在看到亲密家庭或节假日时,这种担忧被Reinforcement,随之出现Anxiety与悲伤.

special_situations.event: Seeing intimate families together或Family gatherings的场景
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not兄弟姐妹或血缘支持,将来就not会有人照顾我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracts attention with hobbies, avoids such scenes and topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我最终会have not人照顾,Loneliness地死去

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 节日have not家人陪伴就意味着我have not支持系统
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not向朋友敞开以避免成为负担,Displacement注意力

special_situations.event: Thinking about being an only child
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 有兄弟姐妹才等于安全与被照顾;have not则注定Loneliness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把注意力Displacement,not去思考或讨论相关内容

special_situations.event: Recalls the support and companionship friends once gave
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 非血缘的支持not可靠,朋友终究not能在关键时刻照料我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate和贬低已有的支持证据
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 朋友现在在,但将来not会在我需要时出现

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be continuously cared for and looked after, with a stable and reliable support relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被孤立,without人理解与照顾;担心暴露脆弱会被评判为夸张或成为负担
defense_goal: 避免向亲友袒露Fear以降低Being rejected/被评价的风险
通过分散注意力压下Loneliness与Fear
Maintaining surface independence to preserve a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: An individual who may be neglected and eventually lonely / a potential burden
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是not可靠或not理解自己,可能认为自己小题大做的人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to consider sharing this specific fear with a close friend
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心他人会认为自己夸张,被自己问题所累,从而not愿敞开
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和,优先Empathy与验证,use开放式问题与小步策略,鼓励评估潜在收益与界限,not施压.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在会谈中聚焦'独生子=Loneliness终老'的主题时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向以抽象推理谈论问题,减少情感卷入以避免not适
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持稳定,Empathy的语调,放慢节奏,邀请其关注当下的身体与情绪感受,帮助其在可承受范围内连接情绪.

manifestations: 担心作为独生子将without人照料而Loneliness死去
看到亲密家庭或在节假日时trigger强烈Loneliness感
not敢向朋友敞开此Fear,害怕成为负担或被误解

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心朋友觉得自己小题大做或成为负担而谨慎克制not开口
在讨论敏感议题时反复自我评估是否会'打扰do not人'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 将想寻求支持的冲动转为自我Repression与消化(用兴趣爱好分散注意力)
在需要安慰时选择独自承受而not求助

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 以Distraction,Displacement注意的方式回避对'Loneliness终老'想法的直接接触
在trigger情境下迅速转开话题或远离相关场景

positive_force: Has a few close and supportive friends
Has self-awareness and expressive ability, can describe thoughts and emotions
Actively seeking help and starting counseling
Positive attitude, willing to try reality testing and behavioral experiments
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的思维倾向
Mental filtering, over-focusing on evidence of lacking siblings
In an all-or-nothing way, equates 'having siblings or not' with 'being cared for or not'
Avoiding asking others for help, worrying about becoming a burden and being evaluated

target_behavior.behavior: 反复出现的灾难化/预测性想法('因为我是独生子,我会Loneliness终老,without人照料'),伴随Anxiety与悲伤
antecedent: 想到自己是独生子与not yet来老年
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Loneliness与失去支持系统的深层Fear,并将'独生子'与'without人照料'作僵化等同
target_behavior.function: 通过反复预测最糟结果以获得对not确定not yet来的虚假控制感,并通过回避暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 频繁Anxiety与悲伤,影响日常生活

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids sharing fears with close friends / seeking support
antecedent: When thinking about discussing the fear with friends
When others suggest sharing feelings or seeking help
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被视为夸张或给他人添麻烦,害怕Being rejected或负面评价
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential shame and rejection experiences, maintaining a sense of safety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: 错失外部支持与纠正性经验,维持Loneliness与without助感
